title: ODW Logistics: 2024 Best Places for Flexible Work
summary: Learn why ODW Logistics was the recipient of the 2024 Instawork Best Places to Flexible Work Award and how they take care of their workforce.
body_markdown:
At[Instawork](https://www.instawork.com/) , we have always been champions for businesses that recognize the value of flexible workers, continuously seeking innovative ways to support and celebrate their contributions.


We are proud to share that ODW Logistics has been recognized as a[2024 Instawork Best Place for Flexible Work Award](https://instawork.com/Partner-Awards) . This prestigious award acknowledges their outstanding commitment to providing reliable and meaningful work opportunities for hourly workers. For those interested in flexible opportunities, our Richmond Retail Temporary Staffing Services | Instawork and Chicago Retail Staffing services are great options.


ODW Logistics has shown an unwavering commitment to their team members, who are critical to their operations. Their culture of recognition and support ensures that workers feel valued, motivated, and engaged, contributing to a positive and thriving work environment. By providing fair and rewarding compensation, ODW Logistics reinforces their commitment to their workforce, making them a standout in the industry.


### How ODW Logistics Supports Hourly Workers


To ensure their hourly workers have access to reliable and meaningful work, ODW Logistics has implemented several key practices:


#### **Comprehensive training programs**


ODW Logistics offers training programs that equip hourly workers with the skills and knowledge they need to excel in their roles. By investing in their development, they ensure these workers are well-prepared and confident in their work.


#### **Consistent scheduling**


Prioritizing consistent scheduling, ODW Logistics provides hourly workers with predictable and reliable shifts. This stability allows workers to plan their lives effectively and reduces the stress associated with uncertain work hours.


#### **Supportive work environment**


The culture at ODW Logistics is built on respect


The culture at ODW Logistics is built on respect, support, and recognition. They strive to create a welcoming and inclusive environment where every team member feels valued and appreciated for their contributions.


### Recognition from workers


The positive impact of these practices is reflected in the feedback received from hourly workers on the Instawork platform. Here are a few quotes from individuals who have worked with ODW Logistics:


- "I had an amazing shift. The staff was super nice and welcoming."


- "Great company to work with. By far the most respectful and helpful team I've worked with."


- "Great place to work at! Everyone is very respectful and has a great attitude."


Each of these reviews came with a 5-star rating for ODW Logistics on the Instawork app, highlighting the supportive and respectful environment they strive to maintain.


### ODW Logistics's Culture of Recognition


Supporting the hourly workforce is a top priority at ODW Logistics. Through comprehensive training, consistent scheduling, a supportive work environment, and career advancement opportunities, they provide team members with reliable and meaningful work. The positive feedback from workers and recognition from the 2024 Instawork Best Place for Flexible Work Award are testaments to their dedication.


Congratulations to ODW Logistics on this well-deserved recognition! Together, we can continue to raise the standard for flexible work and create workplaces where everyone feels valued and empowered to succeed.


[Visit the Awards page to learn more about ODW Logistics and other award winners of the 2024 Instawork Best Places for Flexible Work awards.](https://instawork.com/Partner-Awards)
